scripts.text:
[Ore Tester Sorty]
Do you have ^3131FFany same type of ores in your inventories^000000 which take many spaces?
I can distinguish your ores and organize them right away~!
scripts.translation:
[礦石檢驗員 索爾蒂]
您的背包裡是否有^3131FF佔用大量空間的同類礦石^000000？
我可以立刻幫您鑑別並整理它們哦~！

scripts.text:
[Ore Tester Sorty]
At the moment I can only distinguish ^FF0000Steel^000000, ^FF0000Iron^000000, ^FF0000Iron Ore^000000, and ^FF0000Rough Oridecon^000000 and organize them.
Please note that ^3131FFother items are unable^000000!
scripts.translation:
[礦石檢驗員 索爾蒂]
目前我只能鑑別並整理^FF0000鋼^000000、^FF0000鐵^000000、^FF0000鐵礦石^000000和^FF0000神之金屬原石^000000。
請注意，^3131FF其他物品無法整理^000000！

scripts.text:
[Ore Tester Sorty]
So, would you like me to organize your ores?
scripts.translation:
[礦石檢驗員 索爾蒂]
那麼，您想讓我幫您整理礦石嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ore Tester Sorty]
Huh, I really hate messy people!
scripts.translation:
[礦石檢驗員 索爾蒂]
哎呀，我真的很討厭邋遢的人！

scripts.text:
[Ore Tester Sorty]
You don't have any {0}...
scripts.translation:
[礦石檢驗員 索爾蒂]
您沒有{0}...

scripts.text:
[Ore Tester Sorty]
It's done. Looks great! Don't you think so?
scripts.translation:
[礦石檢驗員 索爾蒂]
整理好了。看起來很棒！您覺得呢？

scripts.text:
[Ore Tester Sorty]
It seems that your bag is clean? Huhu! You might be the master of cleaning!
scripts.translation:
[礦石檢驗員 索爾蒂]
看來您的背包很整潔嘛？呵呵！您一定是整理大師！
